semicolon list of G1 flow statistics, G2 packet size/timing sequences, G3 handshake fields, G4 certificate fields, G5 fingerprints (JA3/JA4) NOTE: count only features the classifier or detector actually uses as input; fields extracted only to filter, label or group flows do NOT count. G1 = whole-flow statistics (duration, byte/packet totals, rates); G2 = sequences of packet/record sizes, directions or timing; G3 = ClientHello/ServerHello fields; G4 = certificate fields (incl. certificate size); G5 = JA3/JA4-style fingerprints

one of tls12, tls13, tls13_ech, decided by the features the proposed method uses, applying the first rule that matches: (1) any field read from the server Certificate message (issuer, subject, validity, SAN, self-signed, chain length, certificate read in cleartext) -> tls12, because TLS 1.3 encrypts certificates; (2) otherwise any ClientHello/ServerHello field, SNI, ALPN, or JA3/JA4/JA3S/JA4S fingerprint -> tls13, because ECH hides the inner ClientHello; (3) otherwise only packet or record sizes, directions, counts, timing or flow statistics (including a certificate size INFERRED from encrypted record lengths) -> tls13_ech NOTE: decide from the features the classifier uses as input only (see feature_groups), not from fields used for filtering or labelling
